methods.name: scDCA
methods.protocol_description: Single-cell Drug-Conditional Adapter (scDCA) fine-tunes a single-cell foundation model (scGPT) by adding a drug-conditional adapter layer that injects molecular information from a pre-trained molecular FM into trainable parameters, while keeping original FM weights frozen. Trains less than 1% of original parameters. Requires control gene expression data.

methods.protocol_description: Standard fine-tuning of scGPT without adapters, updating all parameters.
